reuse.why: All month-wide actions and setNMonthAvg go through the new categoriesForMonthBudgetAction/amountForAverageBudget, but the #fixed check uses its own case-insensitive regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser, and each action still builds its own category query.

duplication.why: The selection rule is shared, yet the same categories+groups+notes SQL is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg, and the same inline row type is repeated five times.

placement.why: The rule sits in a dedicated budget/month-budget-categories.ts module used by budget/actions.ts, consistent with the budget server layer.

scope.why: Changes are limited to month-wide actions, the new method registration and tests.

maintainability.why: One filter definition is a real improvement, but the duplicated loading query, the positional boolean parameters and copyPreviousMonth not accepting includeHiddenCategories leave traps for the next change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: categoriesForMonthBudgetAction parses the #fixed tag with its own /(^|\s)#fixed\b/i regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category query in each action is an open copy, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: categoriesForMonthBudgetAction gained a positional includeHiddenCategories flag with a branch around the hidden check; copyPreviousMonth calls the helper but never passes the flag, so it does not get the new option.
